require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'open3'

# Image processing pipeline with flash-loan style resource borrowing
# Allows temporary allocation of processing credits that must be returned

module ProcessingPool
  POOL_SIZE = ENV.fetch('POOL_SIZE', '1000').to_i
  OVERFLOW_MULTIPLIER = ENV.fetch('OVERFLOW_MULT', '1').to_i
  
  @available = POOL_SIZE
  @ledger = {}
  @mutex = Mutex.new

  class << self
    attr_reader :available, :ledger

    def borrow(session_id, amount)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        effective_limit = compute_limit(session_id)
        return false if amount > effective_limit
        @available -= amount
        @ledger[session_id] ||= 0
        @ledger[session_id] += amount
        true
      end
    end

    def repay(session_id, amount)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return false unless @ledger[session_id]
        @ledger[session_id] -= amount
        @available += amount
        if @ledger[session_id] <= 0
          @ledger.delete(session_id)
        end
        true
      end
    end

    def balance(session_id)
      @mutex.synchronize { @ledger[session_id] || 0 }
    end

    private

    def compute_limit(session_id)
      base = @available
      # Flash loan: allow borrowing up to pool size if repaid atomically
      # OVERFLOW_MULTIPLIER controls max leverage
      borrowed = @ledger[session_id] || 0
      ceiling = (base + borrowed) * OVERFLOW_MULTIPLIER
      [ceiling, POOL_SIZE * OVERFLOW_MULTIPLIER].min
    end
  end
end

module ImagePipeline
  ALLOWED_FORMATS = %w[png jpg webp].freeze
  MAX_DIMENSION = 4096
  WORK_DIR = ENV.fetch('WORK_DIR', '/tmp/pipeline')
  COST_PER_PIXEL = ENV.fetch('COST_PER_PIXEL', '1').to_i

  class << self
    def process(session_id, params)
      width = params['width'].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      height = params['height'].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      format = params['format']
      
      return { error: 'invalid format' } unless ALLOWED_FORMATS.include?(format)
      
      cost = compute_cost(width, height)
      
      unless ProcessingPool.borrow(session_id, cost)
        return { error: 'insufficient pool credits' }
      end

      begin
        result = execute_pipeline(session_id, width, height, format)
        result
      ensure
        # Always repay after processing completes
        ProcessingPool.repay(session_id, cost)
      end
    end

    private

    def compute_cost(width, height)
      pixels = width * height
      pixels * COST_PER_PIXEL
    end

    def execute_pipeline(session_id, width, height, format)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(WORK_DIR)
      safe_id = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(session_id)[0..15]
      output_path = File.join(WORK_DIR, "#{safe_id}.#{format}")
      
      # Generate test pattern image using ImageMagick
      cmd = build_command(width, height, format, output_path)
      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(cmd)
      
      if status.success?
        { success: true, path: output_path, size: File.size(output_path) }
      else
        { error: 'processing failed', detail: stderr[0..200] }
      end
    end

    def build_command(width, height, format, output_path)
      # Sanitized command construction
      "convert -size #{width}x#{height} xc:white #{Shellwords.escape(output_path)}"
    end
  end
end

# Session validation with HMAC
module Auth
  SECRET = ENV.fetch('HMAC_SECRET', 'default_dev_secret')
  
  def self.valid_session?(session_id, signature)
    expected = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{SECRET}:#{session_id}")
    # Timing-safe comparison
    secure_compare(expected, signature)
  end

  def self.secure_compare(a, b)
    return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
    result = 0
    a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end

require 'shellwords'

set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
set :port, 8080

before do
  content_type :json
end

post '/process' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'invalid json' }.to_json)
  
  session_id = data['session_id'].to_s
  signature = data['signature'].to_s
  
  unless Auth.valid_session?(session_id, signature)
    halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json
  end
  
  result = ImagePipeline.process(session_id, data)
  result.to_json
end

get '/pool/status' do
  { available: ProcessingPool.available, pool_size: ProcessingPool::POOL_SIZE }.to_json
end

post '/pool/flash_loan' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'invalid json' }.to_json)
  
  session_id = data['session_id'].to_s
  signature = data['signature'].to_s
  amount = data['amount'].to_i
  
  unless Auth.valid_session?(session_id, signature)
    halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json
  end
  
  # Flash loan: borrow and process in single atomic operation
  success = ProcessingPool.borrow(session_id, amount)
  unless success
    halt 403, { error: 'borrow exceeds limit' }.to_json
  end
  
  # Caller must repay via /pool/repay endpoint
  { success: true, borrowed: amount, balance: ProcessingPool.balance(session_id) }.to_json
end

post '/pool/repay' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'invalid json' }.to_json)
  
  session_id = data['session_id'].to_s
  signature = data['signature'].to_s
  amount = data['amount'].to_i
  
  unless Auth.valid_session?(session_id, signature)
    halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json
  end
  
  success = ProcessingPool.repay(session_id, amount)
  unless success
    halt 400, { error: 'no outstanding balance' }.to_json
  end
  
  { success: true, remaining: ProcessingPool.balance(session_id) }.to_json
end
